notes.title: ver0.1.9 - Update
notes.notes: [h2][b]Additions[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Added “Difficulty 3” to each stage.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a “Lock” feature to the shop.[/p][list][*][p]Locked items will continue to appear in future shop visits.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Overall adjustments to weapon evolution effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Overall adjustments to artifact effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Added possession limits for each artifact.[/p][list][*][p]Artifacts that have reached their limit will no longer appear as options.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Adjusted so that normal enemies also spawn when elite enemies appear.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted so that after a boss enemy appears, a large number of enemies spawn alongside enemy enhancements.[/p][/*][*][p]Added display of remaining ammo and reload status above the character’s head.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted status ailment descriptions to provide more detailed information.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the maximum armor value for characters to “70.”[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the maximum dodge rate for characters to “70%.”[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Adjusted localization for various texts.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed garbled text issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where “Reroll” would not appear when evolving a weapon in the shop.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the visibility of damage number texts.[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor bug fixes.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ver0.1.8 - Update
notes.notes: [h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Adjusted character selection and deployment behavior when using a controller.[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where enemies could spawn outside the map.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where weapons that had already reached max level could still appear as level-up options.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where slimes could be unintentionally destroyed at the start of a stage.[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor bug fixes.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ver0.1.7 - Update
notes.notes: [h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Added detailed effect descriptions to each status ailment.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted to make it clear when effect duration increases upon acquiring duplicate status effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where some character and weapon stats displayed during pause were incorrect.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the level-up option for "Fish Bullet" was not displayed.[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor bug fixes.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ver0.1.6 - Update
notes.notes: [h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Adjusted the stats and effects of the "Bow" weapon.[/p][/*][*][p]Added object indicators such as "Treasure Chests" to the minimap.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted so that chickens drop a certain amount of crystals.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted so that when maximum HP increases, the same amount of HP is gained.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the spawn rate of mission-related objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Made minor stat adjustments to some weapons.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where an error would occur when upgrading to the maximum level using the enhancement feature.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where artifacts would sometimes not drop after defeating a floor boss.[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor bug fixes.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ver0.1.5 - Update
notes.notes: [h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Supports mouse controls.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a "Start" button to the character selection screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the prices of some cards in the "Card Shop".[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where increases in "Pickup Range" were not being applied correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the effects of equipped "Cards" were not being applied properly.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: The free demo version of UNION SURVIVORS is now available!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Dear Survivors, thank you for waiting![/b][/p][p]The demo version of [b]UNION SURVIVORS[/b] is finally available![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470539/f46c4a0c0c3a2ff535030c190122c1c3f7cb443a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Head over to the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3864030/UNION_SURVIVORS_Demo/" style="button"]Steam store page[/url] now and enjoy the game to your heart's content![/p][p][/p][p][b]UNION SURVIVORS[/b] is a roguelite mining survivor game that supports up to 4-player online co-op.
Dig through hordes of slimes, carve your path, and crush waves of enemies![/p][p][i]Note: The current demo version only supports single-player mode.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]To help you get the most out of the demo, we’ve put together a quick Q&A:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: How can I share feedback or report bugs?
A:[/b] Please join our official Discord server, which launched alongside the demo! You're welcome to leave a review on Steam, but Discord will remain our main hub for communication moving forward![/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Will my progress carry over to the full version?
A:[/b] Unfortunately, we do not plan to support save data transfer at this time.
We appreciate your understanding as the demo is built with future adjustments to the full release in mind.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Will the demo receive updates?
A:[/b] Absolutely!
We plan to add features that didn’t make it in time for the initial release, as well as fix bugs and make improvements.
All updates will be announced on Steam and Discord.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: How long will the demo be available?
A:[/b] At minimum, we plan to keep it playable until the full version is released.[/p][p][/p][p]Your feedback means a lot to the entire development team and helps us improve the game.[/p][p]We hope you enjoy playing the [b]UNION SURVIVORS[/b] demo![/p]
